notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
description:
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two Islands to your hand, copying High Tide.
Resolve the copy of High Tide.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two Islands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Activate the Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Each High Tide that has resolved this turn triggers, adding {U}{U} for each trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.
You may also target any other instant/sorcery on the stack using Uyo to create infinite copies of them.
